content: Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. is a state-owned enterprise headquartered in Nanning, the capital city of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in southern China. Established in 1958, the company has evolved over six decades into a comprehensive, integrated chemical enterprise with deep roots in regional industrial development and a growing footprint in China’s national chemical sector. Specializing in the research, production, and marketing of nitrogenous fertilizers—particularly urea, ammonium bicarbonate, and compound fertilizers—the company plays a vital role in supporting agricultural productivity across southern China and beyond. In recent years, Nanning Chemical has proactively pursued green transformation, investing in energy-saving technologies, wastewater recycling systems, and low-emission production processes aligned with China’s dual-carbon (carbon peak and carbon neutrality) goals. It holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications, reflecting its commitments to quality, environmental stewardship, and occupational health and safety. The company operates modern manufacturing facilities equipped with automated control systems and maintains strategic partnerships with agricultural cooperatives, provincial supply and marketing federations, and national fertilizer distribution networks. As a pillar enterprise under Guangxi State-Owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. continues to advance innovation in sustainable agrochemicals, digitalization of production management, and circular economy practices—ensuring its enduring relevance in China’s evolving chemical and agricultural landscape.
